==== /srv/agentq-home/.config/systemd/user/io.agentq.agentq.service
# 由 agentq 生成，改了会被下次安装覆盖。
[Unit]
Description=agentq tick
StartLimitIntervalSec=0

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart="/bin/sh" "/srv/agentq-home/.agentq/tick-guard.sh"
Environment="HOME=/srv/agentq-home"
Environment="PATH=/srv/agentq-home/.local/bin:/srv/agentq-home/.npm-global/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin"
StandardOutput=append:/srv/agentq-home/.agentq/launchd.log
StandardError=append:/srv/agentq-home/.agentq/launchd.log
KillMode=process

==== /srv/agentq-home/.config/systemd/user/io.agentq.agentq.timer
# 由 agentq 生成，改了会被下次安装覆盖。
[Unit]
Description=agentq tick timer

[Timer]
OnActiveSec=0
OnCalendar=*:0/5
AccuracySec=30s

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target

==== /srv/agentq-home/.config/systemd/user/io.agentq.agentq.listen.service
# 由 agentq 生成，改了会被下次安装覆盖。
[Unit]
Description=agentq listen
StartLimitIntervalSec=0

[Service]
Type=simple
Restart=always
RestartSec=10
ExecStart="/srv/agentq-home/.local/bin/agentq" "listen"
Environment="HOME=/srv/agentq-home"
Environment="PATH=/srv/agentq-home/.local/bin:/srv/agentq-home/.npm-global/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin"
StandardOutput=append:/srv/agentq-home/.agentq/launchd.log
StandardError=append:/srv/agentq-home/.agentq/launchd.log
KillMode=process

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
